title: A road condition warning method for driving behavior based on federated learning

pse.problem: Inefficiency in predicting and avoiding potential traffic accidents due to lack of real-time information about surrounding drivers' behavior and road conditions
pse.solution_function: The method collects driver identity, driving behavior data, and road condition analysis data. It uses federated learning combined with differential privacy algorithm for data collection, deep learning for analyzing driving habits, image processing for analyzing driving process risk factors, and calculates the probability of traffic accidents based on the collected data. The system plans driving operation plans according to the calculated potential traffic accident probability.
pse.solution_structure: The key components are in-vehicle camera, face recognition technology, driving recorder, query interface of the traffic control bureau, neural network model, local model parameters, global model parameters, and differential privacy algorithm.
pse.solution_implementation: The in-vehicle camera collects driver's face image when entering the cab for identity determination. The current driver's driving behavior information is collected by calling the query interface of the traffic control bureau and through the in-vehicle camera and driving recorder. The driver's data is protected using differential privacy algorithm combined with federated learning. Each neural network model is trained based on federated learning, local model parameters are obtained, random noise is added to them, and server aggregates the local model parameters to obtain new global model parameters.
pse.effect: The method improves the ability to predict and avoid potential traffic accidents by providing real-time information about surrounding drivers' behavior and road conditions.
